analogy.rationale: Lymphocyte inhibitors act on lymphocyte-specific signaling (e.g., calcineurin/NFAT, mTOR, JAK) that is largely absent in these non-lymphoid cell lines, so they should produce little transcriptional response; calcineurin inhibitors share this lymphocyte-restricted mechanism, while mTOR/JAK inhibitors overlap partially but also hit broadly expressed pathways.
